title: DodagState not thread-safe
description:
File: python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py
Lines: 99-268

DodagState mutates multiple related fields (role, rank, parents, preferred_parent, _lowest_rank) without synchronization.

**Race condition scenario:**
1. Thread A calls process_dio() for neighbor X, enters select_parent()
2. Thread B calls process_dio() for neighbor Y, also enters select_parent()
3. Thread A reads self.parents.values() into admissible list
4. Thread B modifies self.parents (adds Y)
5. Thread A selects parent from stale view, misses better candidate Y
6. Both threads write to self.preferred_parent, self.rank, etc. - last write wins

**Trigger:** Any concurrent DIO processing. While the GIL prevents memory corruption, the interleaving of read-modify-write sequences across multiple attributes can leave state inconsistent.

**Impact:** Preferred parent selection may be suboptimal or inconsistent. _lowest_rank may not reflect the true minimum.

**Fix options:**
1. Document as single-threaded only (acceptable for embedded use)
2. Add threading.Lock around process_dio/select_parent
3. Use copy-on-write pattern for parents dict
